<function name="IsFriendEntityName" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Returns if the given NPC class name is a friend. Returns `true` if the entity name is one of the following:
* `monster_scientist`
* `monster_barney`
* `npc_alyx`
* `npc_barney`
* `npc_citizen`
* `npc_dog`
* `npc_eli`
* `npc_fisherman`
* `npc_gman`
* `npc_kleiner`
* `npc_magnusson`
* `npc_monk`
* `npc_mossman`
* `npc_odessa`
* `npc_vortigaunt`
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<file line="403-L405">lua/includes/util.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="className" type="string">Class name of the entity to check</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Is a friend</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
